Config.Dynamic Lightrays.description: Toggles animated lightrays in farmcave if MMAP is installed.

Config.Farmcave Recolor.description: Changes the look of farmcave walls and ground.
Config.Minecart.name: Minecart
Config.Minecart.description: Adds minecart into farmcave which is connected to vanilla minecarts system.
